To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a circularly polarized compact microstrip patch antenna can be designed using Koch curve fractal shape defected ground structure for mobile applications with improved performance parameters.

the use of fractal Koch curve DGS on circular polarized microstrip antenna improves the performance parameters such as 10 dB impedance, 3 dB axial ration bandwidth and radiation efficiency at the cost of slight reduction in the gain.
a circularly polarized circular disc patch antenna with Koch fractal DGS is proposed for mobile communication.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, fabrication and experimental evaluation of a compact circularly polarized patch antenna with Koch fractal DGS.
the design of a compact circularly polarized (CP) antenna with Koch curve DGS for mobile applications.
the design of circular polarized patch antenna using Koch curve fractal geometry DGS for mobile applications.

the proposed circular disc circularly polarization antenna with Koch curve defected ground structure is a compact antenna with good radiation efficiency, 10 dB bandwidth, 3dB axial ratio bandwidth and gain with respect to conventional circular polarized antenna.
the antenna with Koch curve DGS is a better candidate than its counterpart without DGS in terms of performance parameters.
the proposed design has the potential to replace the conventional simple circular disc antenna with DGS for mobile applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed antenna is a good candidate for compact circular polarized antenna for mobile communication applications.
, with every iteration, the antenna size reduces, while the 3 dB axial-ratio bandwidth, 10 dB impedance bandwidth, and radiation efficiency increase.

the proposed design of circular disc circularly polarization antenna with Koch curve DGS can be a good candidate to be used as an alternative to conventional circularly polarized antennas for mobile applications.

the performance of the antenna can be enhanced by incorporating Koch curve fractal geometry on the ground plane of circular polarized patch antenna.
the proposed antenna can be used for mobile applications.
